name: CNB entrada de paciente
description: POST /http/<workflowId> with one canonical EventoWhatsApp (CNB design D18): validates it and answers { recebido: true, tipo, eventoId }; the fields come out of nodeExecutions[evento].outputs

nodes.name: HTTP Request
nodes.description: Receives an HTTP request and returns the response synchronously

outputs.name: method
outputs.description: The HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.)

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: The full URL of the request

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The path portion of the URL

outputs.name: headers
outputs.description: The HTTP headers as a JSON object

outputs.name: queryParams
outputs.description: The query parameters as a JSON object

outputs.name: body
outputs.description: The raw request body with MIME type

nodes.name: JSON Body
nodes.description: Extracts JSON data from the body of the HTTP request

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Whether the JSON data is required. If false, undefined will be returned when the data is missing

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The parsed JSON data, or undefined if optional and not provided

nodes.name: Validar evento (WhatsApp)
nodes.description: Validate one canonical CNB WhatsApp event and expose its fields

inputs.name: evento
inputs.description: The canonical EventoWhatsApp posted by the CNB

outputs.name: evento
outputs.description: The validated event, with only its canonical fields

outputs.name: tipo
outputs.description: status, mensagem or sessao

outputs.name: provedor
outputs.description: meta or waha

outputs.name: eventoId
outputs.description: Provider event id, the CNB dedupe key

outputs.name: telefone
outputs.description: Patient phone in digits, or null when only an opaque contact is known (mensagem)

outputs.name: contatoOpaco
outputs.description: Opaque contact such as a WAHA @lid, or null (mensagem)

outputs.name: texto
outputs.description: Message text (mensagem)

outputs.name: estado
outputs.description: enviado, entregue, lido or falhou (status); ativa or caida (sessao)

outputs.name: mensagemId
outputs.description: Provider message id (status and mensagem)

nodes.name: Montar resposta
nodes.description: Create a JSON object using a template with variable injection using ${variableName} syntax

inputs.name: template
inputs.description: The JSON template object with variables in ${variableName} format

inputs.name: variables
inputs.description: JSON object containing variable values to inject

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The resulting JSON object with variables replaced

outputs.name: missingVariables
outputs.description: Array of variable names that were not found in the variables object

nodes.name: HTTP Response
nodes.description: Define the HTTP response for synchronous HTTP Request workflows

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: HTTP response headers as a JSON object (Content-Type auto-detected if not provided)

outputs.name: statusCode
outputs.description: HTTP status code

outputs.name: headers
outputs.description: HTTP response headers

outputs.name: body
outputs.description: Response body
